blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.
blocks.zh: 对LLM系统的评价通常在小型即时集中平均,并将模型作为排名表报告。 我们问,这种表格值得多少信任,将基于LLM的即时结构推论作为案例研究:5个家庭的8个开放式模型变体和8B至675B参数、缓存残疾、293个原始中间表述依然存在。 所测量的现象从一开始是不稳定的. 同声呼叫无法可靠地恢复完全相同的结构,平均节点设置Jaccard从0.39到0.96,72%的即时模型细胞从未实现节点设置完美. 审计评价进一步削弱了其结论,这是我们的主要贡献。 在联合组装的靴子凌驾于鼠标之上的情况下,只有排名的底部是坚固的:两个最不易复制的模型在复制品中占据了99%和86%的排名,中间四个占27%至48%,前两个各占68%,因此表格可靠地确定了最差的模型,但不能可靠地确定最好的模型. 合并重复竞选的两条同样站得住脚的规则修改了8行中的4行,将全学科标题移动了7个百分点. 对照地面真实说明检查推断的结构显示可复制性不能被理解为准确性。 而8个终点中的4个在测量后10周内被撤回,因此指定的研究无法再运行. 因此,小样本的LLM评价比其证据支持的更明确。 我们建议报告排名稳定性,每个细胞的出处,执行的敏感性比较,每个运行的原始产出,以及任何排名的衡量日期。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A wave of recent systems treats prompts as programs: as queries to be compiled ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2023 ) , as pipelines to be optimised ( Khattab et al., 2024 ) , or as artefacts over which to define test adequacy ( Tambon et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) . Applied to a prompt not authored in the system’s own format, all of them face the same prerequisite: recover the prompt’s structure. The natural way to do that is to ask a language model. The natural worry is that the model may not answer the same way twice.
blocks.zh: 最近一系列系统将提示视为程序:作为有待汇编的查询(Beurer-Kellner等人,2023年),作为优化的管道(Khattab等人,2024年),或作为界定测试是否充分的手工艺品(Tambon等人,2026年;Tan等人,2026年)。 应用到一个没有以系统本身格式撰写的迅速,他们都面临同样的先决条件:恢复迅速的结构。 这样做的自然方法就是问一个语言模型. 自然担心的是,模型可能无法用同样的方式回答两次.

blocks.en: That worry is well founded and well documented in general terms: temperature-zero decoding does not guarantee determinism ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ; Atil et al., 2025 ) , and repeated-run consistency has been studied for structured extraction ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . Our first contribution measures it specifically for prompt-structure inference, across model families and parameter scales, with the raw outputs released.
blocks.zh: 这种担忧是有根据的,并且有详细的记载:温度零解码并不能保证确定性(Oyang等人,2025年;Atil等人,2025年),并且已经研究过重复运行的一致性,以便进行结构性的提取(姚等人,2026年)。 我们的第一个贡献是专门用来进行快速结构推论的,跨越模范家庭和参数尺度,释放原始产出。

blocks.en: Our central contribution is a claim-level audit of that evaluation. Having ranked eight model variants by reproducibility, we subjected that ranking to the same scrutiny we had applied to the models, and the full ranking does not survive. Four further results depended on undocumented analysis choices: the precedence rule for prompts measured in more than one campaign, absolute versus relative stabilisation tolerance, a criterion satisfied by construction at its endpoint, and the timeout at which a slow model is classified unavailable. Each is an analysis, specification, or instrumentation choice capable of moving a headline without changing the underlying model outputs.
blocks.zh: 我们的核心贡献是对这项评价进行索赔一级的审计。 在通过可复制性对8个模型变体进行排名之后,我们对该排名进行了与对模型相同的审查,而完整的排名是无法存活下来的。 另有四项结果取决于没有记录的分析选择:在一个以上的运动中测得的提示的优先权规则、绝对的相对稳定耐受性、建筑在其终点上满足的标准、以及一个缓慢的模型无法分类的超时。 每一个都是一种分析、规格或仪器选择,能够移动一个标题而不改变基本模型输出。

blocks.en: Table 2 collects seven claims and assumptions examined in the self-audit and records which survive. The failure mode is likely to matter beyond this study. Evaluations built from tens of prompts and a handful of models, with a metric averaged per model and sorted, are cheap to run and easy to cite, and the sorting is the part a reader retains and the part the sample size supports least.
blocks.zh: 表2收集了在自我审计和记录中审查的7项索赔和假设。 失败模式可能在本研究之外有所影响。 从几十个提示和少数模型中构建的评价,每个模型的公尺平均值和排序,运行成本低廉,容易引用,排序是读者保留的部分,样本大小支持的部分最少.

blocks.en: The paper proceeds in four steps, from the instability of the measurement to the instability of everything built on top of it.
blocks.zh: 论文分四个步骤进行,从测量的不稳定性到上面所建的一切的不稳定性.

blocks.en: § 4 . Does the measurement reproduce? Jaccard and ID-stability across repeated identical calls; whether the gap is a property of the model or of scale within a family; whether corpus type shifts it; and what drifts when the IR drifts. § 5 . Do the conclusions reproduce? How many reruns a consumer must average before its signal stabilises, and whether the resulting ranking survives resampling and defensible changes of analysis. § 6 . Reproducibility is not validity. Whether a stable IR is also a correct one, against ground-truth annotations. § 7 . Reproducibility over time. Whether the study can be run again at all, ten weeks later.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Most prompts in the wild are unstructured natural language. To apply a program-style toolchain, a system must first ask a model to read the prompt and emit a serialisable intermediate representation (IR): a list of typed nodes ( Rule , Condition , Breakpoint , Directive ), each carrying a string id, a category, an optional priority, and a source range. We treat this IR as a black-box output and ask only whether the same prompt yields the same one.
blocks.zh: 野外大多数的提示语是无结构的自然语言. 要应用一个程序式的工具链,系统必须首先要求一个模型读取一个可序列的中间代表(IR):一个打出的节点列表(规则,条件,断点,指令),每个节点都带有字符串ID,一个类别,一个可选的优先级,以及一个源区域. 我们把这个IR当作一个黑盒输出,只问同一个即时输出是否同一个.

blocks.en: One evaluated support-ticket prompt contains the line // @rule RULE:urgency_assessment category=policy priority=2 , followed by the instruction to assess a ticket as high, medium, or low urgency. One run emitted a node with id RULE:urgency_assessment , kind Rule , inferred=false , category policy , and priority 2. The same run also added an unmarked RULE:conditional_logic section with inferred=true . Thus one IR can contain both copied explicit structure and structure recovered from ordinary prompt text; the persisted JSON records also include labels, triggers, confidence, and source ranges.
blocks.zh: 一个经过评估的支持-计票提示包含行///@rule Rule Rule:urgency_assession category=policy policy policy=2,然后指示评估一张票的高,中,或低紧急度. 一次运行发布了一个节点,有 id Rule:gency_assession, kind Rules, express=虚假, 类别政策和优先级 2. 同一运行还增加了一个没有标记的 RuLE:有条件_logic 区段,并附有推论=真值。 因此,一个IR可以同时包含从普通的即时文本中恢复的复制的显式结构和结构;持续存在的JSON记录还包括标签,触发器,置信度和源域.

blocks.en: The inference instruction tells the model that explicit // @rule annotations may be present and should be emitted with inferred=false , and that further rules be inferred and marked inferred=true . The task therefore has two components, transcribing marked structure and recovering unmarked structure, and our synthesised corpus is annotated, so it is dominated by the first: across the 293 persisted IRs the share of nodes marked explicit runs from 64% to 100%, most models between 77% and 92%. Table 1 is thus mostly transcription reproducibility, which sharpens the headline rather than softening it: these models are shown delimited structure, told to copy it, and still do not return the same node set twice. The unannotated regime is the recovery campaign of § 4 .
blocks.zh: 推断指示告诉模型,可能存在明示的//@rule说明,并且应当以推断的/虚假的/发布,并且进一步的规则应当推断和标记推断的/真实的/. 因此,这项任务有两个组成部分,即转录标记结构和恢复无标记结构,我们的合成体是附加说明的,因此它以第一个部分为主:在293个持续存在的IR中,标定的结点的比例从64%到100%,大多数型号在77%到92%之间。 因此,表1大多是抄写可复制性,它使头条变尖而不是软化:这些模型被显示为被划定的结构,被告知要复制,仍然不返回两次相同的节点设定. 未加说明的政权是第4节的追回行动。

blocks.en: A linter, a coverage tool, or an agent that debugs a teammate’s prompt cannot offer the guarantee that ordinary static analysis offers routinely, that the same input yields the same diagnosis tomorrow, if the structure it reasons over is itself resampled on every call. We are measuring that precondition, not the downstream tool.
blocks.zh: 一个linter,一个覆盖工具,或者一个调试队友的提示的代理人不能提供普通静态分析例行提供的保证,如果它所解释的结构在每一次通话上都得到复制,同样的输入在明天产生相同的诊断. 我们正在衡量这一先决条件,而不是下游的工具。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We used one commercial open-model endpoint and attempted ten models spanning family, parameter scale, and reasoning style. Eight met our inclusion threshold of at least 3 prompts completing at least 2 of R R runs: gemma3:12b (Google); gpt-oss:20b and gpt-oss:120b (OpenAI-style); ministral-3:8b and mistral-large-3:675b (Mistral); minimax-m2.1 and minimax-m2.7 (MiniMax); qwen3-coder-next (Alibaba).
blocks.zh: 我们用了一个商业开放模式的终点 并尝试了十种模式 跨越家族,参数尺度和推理风格。 8个达到了至少3个速率完成至少2个R跑的加入阈值:gemma3:12b(Google);gpt-oss:20b和gpt-oss:120b(OpenAI式);minstral-3:8b和mistral-大-3:675b(Mistral);minimax-m2.1和minimax-m2.7(MiniMax);qwen3-coder-next(阿里巴)。

blocks.en: Two did not. deepseek-v3.1:671b returned no successful inference across the attempts we logged; § 7 makes our client timeout the leading candidate, but the model is retired and we cannot now establish the cause. glm-4.7 returned 5 successful runs across 2 prompts (Jaccard 0.80 and 1.00), real data falling below our 3-prompt inclusion threshold. It is excluded from Table 1 by that threshold rather than by failure, a distinction worth recording since the artefact contains those 5 IRs.
blocks.zh: 两个没有。 Deepseek-v3.1:671b在我们记录的尝试中没有成功回溯推论;§7使我们的客户超时成为领先候选人,但模型已经退役,我们现在无法确立原因. glm-4.7返回了5次成功运行,跨越了2个提示(Jaccard 0.80和1.00),实际数据低于我们的3个速率包含阈值。 根据这一阈值,而不是失败,它被排除在表1之外,这是一个值得记录的区别,因为人工活性含有这5个IR。

blocks.en: Two corpora. The synthesised corpus on disk holds 83 annotated prompts: 80 generated across a rotating list of 30 application domains and three hand-authored seeds. The generator’s released instruction requests at least four rules, two conditions, and nested branching, and the generated files were retained rather than paraphrased into additional variants. The campaigns reported here measured 22 distinct prompt files, and raw IRs were persisted for 20 (the flag that saves them was added partway through). Repeated runs submit the same prompt file and inference instruction with caching disabled; there are no hidden prompt variants. We state the counts 83, 22, and 20 because they are easy to conflate. Table 1 and the drift analysis therefore rest on 22 and 20 prompts respectively, not on 83.
blocks.zh: 两只蝎子 磁盘上的合成体有83个附加说明的提示:80个通过30个应用域和三个手写种子的旋转列表生成。 生成器发布的指令要求至少四个规则,两个条件,以及嵌入的分支,生成的文件被保留,而不是被译为额外的变体. 这里报道的运动测量了22个不同的快速文件,20个原始的IRs被持续使用(保存它们的旗帜被部分添加). 重复运行提交相同的即时文件和推断指令,但缓存已禁用;没有隐藏的即时变体. 我们指出83、22和20条罪状 因为它们很容易被混淆 因此,表1和漂移分析分别取决于22和20个速率,而不是83个。

blocks.en: The second corpus is 40 license-gated real-world SKILL.md prompts collected from 40 distinct public GitHub repositories under permissive licences (38 MIT, 1 Apache-2.0, 1 Unlicense), with attribution and content-hash deduplication; 23 completed at least 2 runs within budget. Real prompts are passed to inference as-is, which is the setting a tool ingesting existing prompts actually faces.
blocks.zh: 第二套是40个许可证发放的实境SKILL.md提示,根据许可许可从40个不同的公共GitHub仓库(38个MIT、1个Apache-2.0、1个Unlicense)收集,其归属和内容分散;23个至少完成2个在预算范围内运行。 真实的提示被传递到推论-is,这就是设定一个实际吞噬现有提示的工具.

blocks.en:
For a prompt we run inference R R times ( R R between 2 and 5, set per campaign by rate-limit headroom) with caching disabled, obtaining IRs { I 1 , … , I R } \{I_{1},\dots,I_{R}\} .
Write ids ⁡ ( I ) \mathrm{ids}(I) for an IR’s node-id set. Node-set Jaccard averages agreement over run pairs : the mean of | ids ⁡ ( I i ) ∩ ids ⁡ ( I j ) | / | ids ⁡ ( I i ) ∪ ids ⁡ ( I j ) | |\mathrm{ids}(I_{i})\cap\mathrm{ids}(I_{j})|/|\mathrm{ids}(I_{i})\cup\mathrm{ids}(I_{j})| over all ( R 2 ) \binom{R}{2} of them. ID-stability instead demands agreement across all R R runs at once: | ⋂ i ids ⁡ ( I i ) | / | ⋃ i ids ⁡ ( I i ) | |\bigcap_{i}\mathrm{ids}(I_{i})|/|\bigcup_{i}\mathrm{ids}(I_{i})| . The first is the more forgiving of the two.
A cell is node-set-perfect when both equal 1. We name it that way deliberately: it means the node-id sets agreed, not that the IRs were identical. Metadata and hierarchy can still differ, and in our data they sometimes do, so calling this "perfect reproducibility" would overstate what the metric sees.

When Jaccard < 1 <1 we classify each pairwise disagreement as exactly one of: id-label drift (same node count and kind distribution, different ids); count drift (different node counts or kind distribution); metadata drift (same ids and kinds, differing source range, category or other per-node metadata). Calling the third category hierarchy drift would overstate it: the IR as emitted is a flat node list with no parent-child relation, so the bucket measures per-node metadata disagreement, chiefly source ranges.
blocks.zh: 当Jaccard < 1 < 1时,我们把每个对偶的分歧归类为: id- label 漂移(相同的节点计数和类型分布,不同的ids); 计数漂移(不同的节点计数或类型分布); 元数据漂移(相同的IDs和类型,不同的源域,类别或其他每个节点的元数据) 。 调用第三类层次漂移会过分夸大其词:释放的IR是一个没有父子关系的平坦节点列表,因此每个节点元数据都用桶测量,主要是源范围.

blocks.en: Means carry 95% percentile bootstrap intervals over 10,000 prompt resamples. Within-family contrasts use a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-prompt Jaccard, restricted to prompts both models completed. Because tie handling changes the result at these sample sizes, we report both the zero-splitting and the zero-dropping convention. Rank stability is estimated by a joint cluster bootstrap: one prompt multiset is drawn per replicate, every model is scored on that same draw, and the table is re-sorted.
blocks.zh: 意味着携带95%的靴子间隔 超过10,000个快速的复标。 家族内部对比使用每时每刻的Jacccard上一个对齐的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,仅限于提示两个模型完成. 因为平齐处理会改变这些样本大小的结果,所以我们既报告零分和零投放的常规. 排名稳定性通过一个联合组群靴子来估计:每复制一个即时多集,每个模型都在同一图上打分,表格重新排序。

blocks.en: The main table is an incomplete, unbalanced panel rather than a fully crossed benchmark: campaigns covered different prompt subsets, and completion failures further changed each row’s support. Raw cross-row differences are therefore descriptive, not controlled pairwise effects. The within-family tests above are the only model contrasts we treat as paired, and they use only prompts completed by both variants; Table 1 reports each row’s actual n n so the unmatched coverage remains visible.
blocks.zh: 主要表格是一个不完整、不平衡的面板,而不是一个完全跨过的基准:运动涵盖不同的即时子集,完成失败进一步改变了每行的支持。 因此,原始的跨行差异是描述性的,而不是控制的对偶效应. 上面的家族内部测试是我们视为配对的唯一模型对比,它们只使用两个变体完成的提示; 表1报告了每行的实际nn,因此未匹配的覆盖范围仍然可见。

blocks.en: Measurements were collected in several campaigns at different wall-clock budgets, so a given prompt-model pair can appear more than once. We resolve duplicates by preferring the higher-budget campaign, and we publish the per-cell provenance table alongside the results. This rule is stated because, as § 5 shows, it is not neutral.
blocks.zh: 不同时钟预算的几项运动中都收集了测量数据,因此给定的即时模型组合可以不止一次出现. 我们更喜欢高预算运动来解决重复问题,我们公布每个细胞的出处表和结果。 这一规则之所以提出,是因为正如第5节所示,它不是中立的。

blocks.en: 4 Does the measurement reproduce?
blocks.zh: 页:1 测量是否复制?

blocks.en: The first four questions ask whether the phenomenon is stable enough to support a ranking at all.
blocks.zh: 前四个问题询问现象是否稳定,完全支持排名.

blocks.en: 4.1 How reproducible is it?
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 如何是可复制的?

blocks.en: Table 1 gives the picture. Mean Jaccard runs from 0.39 to 0.96 and ID-stability from 0.22 to 0.96. Across all 127 prompt-model cells, 35 (28%) are node-set-perfect.
blocks.zh: 表1显示了情况。 平均Jaccard从0.39到0.96,ID稳定性从0.22到0.96。 在所有127个快速模型细胞中,35个(28%)是节点设置完美的。

blocks.en: The bootstrap intervals deserve as much attention as the point estimates. gpt-oss:120b at 0.39 has a 95% interval of [ 0.25 , 0.54 ] [0.25,0.54] , and minimax-m2.7 at 0.70 has [ 0.47 , 0.89 ] [0.47,0.89] on n = 6 n=6 . These are not narrow measurements. Most adjacent pairs have overlapping intervals; the exceptions are the well-separated top and bottom of the table, where for instance gemma3:12b at [ 0.90 , 0.98 ] [0.90,0.98] and mistral-large-3:675b at [ 0.73 , 0.86 ] [0.73,0.86] do not overlap.
blocks.zh: 靴子间隔应该像点估计一样受到重视。 gpt-oss:120b at 0.39的间隔为95% [0.25,0.54] [0.25,0.54],而0.70的迷你max-m2.7在n = 6 n = 6. 这些不是狭义的测量。 大多数相邻的配对有重叠的间隔;例外是表的上下分明,例如[0.90,0.98] [0.90,0.98]的gemma3:12b和[0.73,0.86]的mistral-group-3:675b没有重叠.

blocks.en: Table 1: Stability across eight model variants on the synthesised corpus, sorted by Jaccard. n n is prompts completing at least 2 of R R runs. blocks.en: The panel above is mostly transcription (§ 2 ). To measure recovery we ran a second campaign, crossed by design: 11 currently-served models on the same 19 genuinely unannotated real SKILL.md files, three runs each, one time window. The design calls for 627 outputs and 557 persisted, so the analysed panel is not fully crossed: we analyse the 196 cells with at least two runs, and the 70 missing outputs are not missing at random, since a model that fails is likelier to fail again. Appendix C has the per-cell completion counts.

blocks.en: Recovery scores far lower, though the comparison is not clean: annotation status, corpus, prompt content, model panel and completion pattern all change together between the two regimes, so what follows is a level difference and not an isolated effect of recovery. Mean node-set Jaccard over the 196 cells is 0.22 , against 0.39 to 0.96 per model in the annotated regime, and 30 cells (15%) score exactly zero, repeated runs of the same model on the same prompt sharing no node id at all. Per model the exact-id mean runs from 0.73 ( gemma4:31b ) down to 0.05 ( nemotron-3-nano:30b ); under the normalised metric introduced below the ordering at the bottom changes slightly, with minimax-m2.7 lowest at 0.11.

blocks.en: An exact-id metric is unfair here in a way it is not on annotated input, since there is no canonical naming: two runs can agree completely about content yet score zero by calling one unit SECTION_WHEN_TO_USE and RULE:WHEN_TO_USE . blocks.en: 4.4 What drifts

blocks.en: Across 98 prompt-model cells with persisted raw IRs, drift is dominated by count disagreements: 19% id-label, 49% count, 31% metadata, as a macro mean over cells. The ordering is stable across every aggregation we tried (pooling raw disagreement pairs gives 19/47/33; restricting to cells that actually disagree gives 20/49/31), so the headline is safe even though the exact figures are not.

blocks.en: Models do not mostly rename a stable skeleton, which id canonicalisation would fix; they disagree about how many nodes there are, so canonicalisation would address under a fifth of the drift. One panel mismatch: the 98 cells include glm-4.7 and exclude gpt-oss:20b , whose campaign predated the flag that saves raw IRs, so the drift panel and Table 1 are both eight models but not the same eight.

blocks.en: 5 Do the conclusions reproduce?
blocks.zh: 页:1 这些结论能复制吗?

blocks.en: The rest of the paper turns the same scrutiny on the evaluation itself, asking here whether the answers above survive resampling and defensible changes of analysis.
blocks.zh: 本文的其余部分对评价本身也进行了同样的审查,在此询问上述答案是否还能够经受住分析的再现和无可辩驳的变化。

blocks.en: 5.1 How many reruns a consumer needs
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 消费者需要重新运行多少次

blocks.en: Our stabilisation analysis was wrong twice, and both errors are analysis-specification failures rather than results about models, so we summarise here and give the detail in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们的稳定性分析两次是错误的,而且这两个错误都是分析与规格的失败,而不是模型的结果,所以我们在这里概括并给出附录C的细节。

blocks.en: The criterion is satisfied by construction at its endpoint, since with R R runs the long-run mean is the mean of all R R , so r = R r=R always passes and "did not stabilise" is unreachable, accounting for 48 of 98 cells. And the tolerance was documented as relative to the long-run mean but implemented as an absolute 0.05 nodes ; on trajectories whose long-run means range from 5.3 to 18.0 nodes those two readings give 80 and 50 of 98 cells stabilising. Nothing in the data distinguishes them.
blocks.zh: 该标准通过在其端点的构造而满足,因为随着R R 运行长期平均值是所有R R 的平均值,因此r = R = R R = R 总是通过,"没有稳定"是无法到达的,占98个单元格中的48个. 而耐受性被记录为相对于长期平均值,但作为绝对0.05节点执行;在长期值介于5.3至18.0节点的轨迹上,这两个读数给出了98个细胞中的80个和50个. 数据中没有任何区别。

blocks.en: We also do not measure a downstream tool: the signal is IR node count, a proxy for any quantity a consumer might derive, and no linter finding or coverage value is computed. All we will claim is that among cells stabilising strictly before their endpoint the median is r = 1 r=1 under both readings, so where averaging helps it helps immediately. This design does not support a recommendation that any fixed number of reruns suffices.
blocks.zh: 我们还不衡量下游工具:信号是IR节点计数,是消费者可能获得的任何数量的代名词,没有计算网间查找值或覆盖值。 我们所宣称的是,在严格在细胞末点之前的细胞中, 中间值是r = 1 r = 1, 在这两个读数下, 平均值帮助它立即发挥作用。 这种设计并不支持关于任何固定的重运行次数都足够的建议。

blocks.en: Table 2: Seven claims and assumptions examined in our self-audit. Only one remains strongly supported. Each row is established in the section named; none required new measurements.
blocks.zh: 表2:我们自行审计审查的7项索赔和假设。 只有一人仍然得到大力支持。 每行都设于命名的区块中;不需要新的测量.

blocks.en: 5.2 Does the ranking survive resampling and analysis choices?
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 排名是否在重新取样和分析的选择中存活下来?

blocks.en: The final column of Table 1 reports how often each model retains its listed rank under a joint cluster bootstrap: one prompt multiset is drawn per replicate and every model scored on that draw, preserving the pairing an independent per-model resample would destroy. Of 10,000 replicates, 9,583 were usable; the rest contained no prompt measured by the n = 3 n=3 model.
blocks.zh: 表1的最后一栏报告每个模型在联合组装靴子下保留其上列等级的情况:每个复制人绘制一个快速多集,每个模型在该图上得分,保留每个模型的独立再模拟的配对将破坏。 在10 000件复制品中,有9 583件可以使用;其余的没有用n=3n=3模型测量的速率。

blocks.en: Only the bottom holds: gpt-oss:120b stays last in 99% of replicates and qwen3-coder-next seventh in 86%. The middle four range from 27% to 48%, close to a coin flip. The top is no firmer: minimax-m2.1 and gemma3:12b hold position in only 68% each, and which leads is undetermined at n = 3 n=3 against n = 22 n=22 .
blocks.zh: 只有底部持有:gpt-oss:120b在99%的复制品中停留在最后,Qwen3-coder-next 7在86%. 中间四位从27%到48%,接近硬币翻转. 顶部没有更坚固:mimmax-m2.1和gemma3:12b各只持有68%的姿势,其铅在n=3n=3对n=22n=22时未确定.

blocks.en: So the table supports " gpt-oss:120b is the least reproducible model we tested" but does not reliably identify the most reproducible. Retention frequency is a bootstrap diagnostic, not a posterior probability, and it is strict: a model displaced by one position may still be well separated from the field. Rank confidence intervals ( Neuhof and Benjamini, 2026b ) would be the more principled instrument, and we report retention only as a diagnostic.
blocks.zh: 因此该表支持"gpt-oss:120b是我们测试过的可复制度最低的模型",但没有可靠地识别出最可复制的模型. 保留频率是一种靴子陷阱诊断,而不是后期概率,而且严格:一个位置所取代的模型可能仍然与球场完全分离. 排名信任间隔(Neuhof和Benjamini,2026年b)将是比较有原则的文书,我们报告保留只是作为诊断。

blocks.en: We claim the application, not the method. Rank uncertainty for leaderboards has an emerging machinery: error bars on evaluations ( Miller, 2024 ) , rank confidence and prediction intervals ( Neuhof and Benjamini, 2026a ; Neuhof and Benjamini, 2026b ) , leaderboard tops flipped by sub-1% perturbations ( Oyarhoseini et al., 2026 ) , and naive standard errors 40 to 60% too small once judge and phrasing variance are accounted for ( Messing, 2026 ) . We introduce no new rank-uncertainty estimator; our contribution is applying uncertainty analysis as one stage of an end-to-end audit of a concrete evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们声称申请,而不是方法。 领导板的排名不确定性有一个新兴机制:评价错误栏(Miller, 2024),排名自信和预测间隔(Neuhof和Benjamini, 2026a;Neuhof和Benjamini, 2026b),领导板顶部被子-1%的扰动翻转(Oyarhoseini等人, 2026),以及天真的标准错误40-60%太小,一旦判断和措辞差异被计算在内(Messing, 2026). 我们没有引进新的不确定评级;我们的贡献是将不确定性分析作为对具体评价的端到端审计的一个阶段。

blocks.en: Our measurements accumulated over several campaigns at different budgets, so some prompt-model pairs were measured more than once. Preferring the higher-budget campaign is one reasonable rule; preferring the earliest and topping up from later ones only for prompts not yet covered is another, which is what an analyst assembling results incrementally would do, and it was applied here without being recorded.
blocks.zh: 我们的测量是在不同的预算上通过几次运动积累起来的,所以一些迅速的模型对被测量了不止一次. 更倾向于高预算运动是一条合理的规则;更倾向于最早的和较晚的,只针对尚未覆盖的提示,是另一条规则,这就是一个逐渐收集结果的分析师会做的,它在这里被应用而没有被记录。

blocks.en: Two rows of Table 1 rest on n = 3 n=3 and n = 6 n=6 . A table sorted by a point estimate invites comparison between every pair of rows, and we make no multiplicity correction for the 28 implied comparisons because the study was not designed to support them. At these sample sizes a sorted table is better read as a partition into "clearly reproducible", "clearly not", and "undetermined", and most of our models fall in the third group.
blocks.zh: 表1的两行分别是n=3n=3,n=6n=6. 按点数估计排序的表格会让每一行进行对比,我们不会对28个隐含的比较进行多重更正,因为研究的目的并不是要支持这些比较。 在这些样本大小上,一个排序的表格最好被读作"清晰可复制","明显不可复制","未确定"的分区,我们大多数的模型属于第三组.

blocks.en: 6 Reproducibility is not validity
blocks.zh: 6个 可复制性不是有效性

blocks.en: Agreement between runs is not agreement with truth. The synthesised prompts are annotated and the deterministic parser recovers those annotations exactly, so re-reading the 293 persisted IRs offline gives ground truth for the explicit structure with no new inference. Mean recall of the annotated node ids is 0.86, and mean precision restricted to nodes the model itself marked explicit is 0.82: roughly one in five nodes a model asserted it had copied corresponds to no annotation in the file.
blocks.zh: 各行各业之间的协议与事实不符。 综合提示被附加说明,决定性解析器完全恢复了这些说明,因此重新读取293个持续存在的IRs离线,为清晰的结构提供了没有新推论的地盘真理. 附加说明的节点标识的平均值为0.86,标定的标定型号本身标定的节点的精确度为0.82:它所复制的模型大约每五个节点中就有一个符合文件中的注释。

blocks.en: Stability and correctness also order the models differently, and how strongly they associate depends on which correctness metric is chosen, from Pearson r = 0.69 r=0.69 under all-node precision to r = 0.90 r=0.90 under explicit precision, with none of the four surviving the removal of the single low outlier. Appendix B has the per-model figures, the metric definitions and all four correlations; the panels differ too, stability being prompt-weighted over the merged cells and correctness run-weighted over 288 runs in 110 cells. We therefore claim only that the orderings diverge, and the practical consequence stands regardless: a reproducibility ranking cannot be read as an accuracy ranking, and a practitioner choosing on Table 1 alone would take mistral-large-3:675b over ministral-3:8b and get the less accurate of the two.
blocks.zh: 稳定性和正确性也给模型排序不同,其关联程度如何取决于选择哪一个正确性度量度,从全节点精度下的皮尔逊 r = 0.69 r = 0.69到明确精度下的r = 0.90 r = 0.90,四个都无法幸存的去除单一的低离子. 附 录 B有每个模型的数字,度量衡定义和所有四种关联;面板也不同,稳定性在合并的细胞上被迅速加权,正确性在110个细胞中被运行的超过288个. 因此,我们只声称,订单有差异,实际后果无论如何:不可将可复制性排名理解为准确排名,而仅在表1上选择的从业者会将迷你-3:675b比迷你-3:8b大,得到两者中不太准确的结果。

blocks.en: 7 Reproducibility over time
blocks.zh: 页:1 可长期复制

blocks.en: We re-queried the endpoint for every model this study names. Of the eight variants in Table 1 , four are no longer served , all withdrawn on 2026-07-15, a month after our measurements. The provider returns HTTP 410 with an explicit retirement date and reference id, so this is not a transient outage. Of the fifteen models originally named, ten are gone across two waves (2026-06-16 and 2026-07-15); Appendix A has the audit.
blocks.zh: 我们重审了每个模型的终点 表1的8个变体中,有4个不再服务,都是在2026-07-15年,也就是我们测量一个月后撤回的. 供应商返回HTTP 410时带有明确的退休日期和参考代号,因此这不是短暂的出局. 在最初命名的15个模型中,有10个跨越了两波(2026-06-16和2026-07-15); A有审计。

blocks.en: The study as specified is therefore no longer executable. gemma3:12b , second in Table 1 and the anchor of the annotated real-corpus comparison, cannot be queried by us or by a reviewer, so half the ranking § 5 was careful to qualify now rests on subjects nobody can re-examine.
blocks.zh: 因此,上述研究已不再可以执行。 gemma3:12b),表1第二位和附加说明的真人公司比较的主播,我们或审查者都无法质疑,因此排名第5节的一半仔细地确定了资格,现在的题目是没有人可以重新审查的。

blocks.en: An earlier version of this study called DeepSeek and Zhipu structurally inaccessible. The likelier explanation is a single constant in our own client: the default analysis timeout returns 60,000 ms, overridable by no flag, and anything slower is logged as a connection failure, which is the exact signature reported. Many current models emit a separate reasoning trace before answering, and our client caps no tokens, so a reasoning-heavy model runs past the deadline.
blocks.zh: 这个研究的早期版本称为DeepSeek和Zhipu结构上无法访问. 比较相似的解释是我们自己的客户端中一个单一的常数:默认分析超时返回6万 ms,无旗帜压倒,任何较慢的都会被记录为连接失败,这就是所报告的确切的签名. 许多现今的模型在回答之前会发出一个单独的推理追踪,我们的客户端没有封面符,所以一个推理重的模型会跑过最后期限.

blocks.en: Probing 11 currently-served models twice on one prompt, under a tight output budget and a generous one (Appendix D ), eight fail under the tight budget and return valid JSON with room ; seven of those eight finish inside 60 s, nemotron-3-ultra needs 77.7 s and would be discarded whatever the budget. Of the three that work under both, mistral-large-3:675b and gemma4:31b emit no reasoning at all, while glm-5.2 emits 4,372 characters, close to the median of 4,906 among the other eight. Reasoning volume therefore separates the extremes without cleanly partitioning the groups, and we do not claim it as the mechanism. Two hazards separate here: the timeout is the leading candidate for what broke this study, though the failure could not be reproduced, while the budget is an independent trap for anyone who sets a cap. Either makes reasoning-heavy families look unreachable, and DeepSeek and Zhipu are reasoning-model families.
blocks.zh: 在紧缺的产出预算和慷慨预算(附录D)下,试探11种目前使用的模型两次,其中8种在紧缺的预算下失败,并将有效的JSON带回房间;这8种模型中有7种在60s内完成,Nemotron-3-ultra需要77.7s,无论预算如何,都将被抛弃。 在两者下的三个作品中,mistral-group-3:675b和gemma4:31b完全不产生推理,而glm-5.2则发出4,372个字符,接近其他8个中位数4,906个. 因此,理性的量将极端区分开来,而不对各群体进行干净的划分,我们不声称它是机制。 这里有两个不同的危险: 超时是打破这个研究的主要候选者, 尽管失败无法复制, 而预算是任何设定上限的人的独立陷阱。 要么让推理繁重的家庭看起来无法接触,DeepSeek和Zhipu是推理模型家庭.

blocks.en: We therefore withdraw the accessibility finding. The original evidence could not distinguish model, provider, timeout, schema or harness failure, and the five successful GLM runs already contradicted the family-level claim. We have not reproduced the historical failure: those models are retired, our probe uses a simplified extraction prompt rather than the typed IR request, and the budget condition is not one the harness ever applied. The cause is unresolved; the instrument is the leading candidate.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们撤回无障碍调查。 原始证据无法区分模型、提供者、超时、计划或操纵故障,5个成功的GLM运行已经与家庭一级的索赔相矛盾。 我们没有重复历史的失败:这些模型已经退役,我们的探测器使用了简化的提取提示而不是输入的IR请求,而且预算状况不是曾经应用过的绳索。 原因尚未解决;文书是主要候选人。

blocks.en: Deprecation and silent revision are documented ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , and so is this failure, which we do not claim to be first to name. Johnson and Obradovich (2024) report that after OpenAI withdrew text-davinci-003 the prompts from their own published study could no longer be resubmitted, leaving data and code inspectable but the generating process unrepeatable; Angermeir et al. (2025) find the same mechanism at venue scale, naming deprecated models the one reproduction blocker specific to commercial LLMs; and Baltes et al. (2026) responds with guidelines whose fourth item is to report session traces. Our case adds a dated quantification on a study whose raw outputs survive: ten of fifteen named models gone between measurement (30 May to 11 June 2026) and audit (17 August 2026). It survives only because 293 raw IRs were persisted, from which the drift, stabilisation and correctness analyses regenerate offline; had we kept only summary CSVs, half this paper would be unfalsifiable. If an evaluation targets a hosted endpoint, treat raw per-run outputs as the primary artifact, date every measurement, and present the ranking as a dated document.
blocks.zh: 折旧和无声修订有记载(马等,2024年;陈等,2024年),这次失败也是如此,我们并不自称是先名. Johnson和Obradovich(2024年)报告说,OpenAI撤回文本-davinci-003之后,他们自己公布的研究的提示不再可以重新提交,使得数据和代码可以检查,但生成过程无法重复;Angermeir等人(2025年)在会场规模上发现了同样的机制,命名了被腐烂的模型,即商业LLMs特有的一个复制阻断器;Baltes等人(2026年)回应了准则,其第四个项目是报告会话痕迹. 我们的案例对一项原始产出尚存的研究增加了一个过时的量化:15个命名模型中有10个在计量(2026年5月30日至6月11日)和审计(2026年8月17日)之间。 它之所以能生存下来,只是因为293个原始的IR一直存在,从中漂移、稳定和正确性分析再生出离线;如果我们只保留摘要CSV,那么本文的一半是不可伪造的。 如果评价目标为主机终点,将每个运行的原始产出作为主要文物,确定每项计量的日期,并将排名作为日期文件提出。

blocks.en: 8 Threats to validity
blocks.zh: 8 对有效性的威胁

blocks.en: Run-to-run disagreement, bootstrap rank movement, and merge-rule sensitivity concern how much inference the sampled outputs support. The endpoint timeout and the two stabilisation mistakes instead concern our instrument and analysis specification. Those mistakes are evidence that an evaluation pipeline can fail under audit, not evidence of intrinsic LLM nondeterminism. We keep the two classes separate in the results and withdraw the accessibility claim whose instrument could not identify its cause.
blocks.zh: 运行到运行的分歧、靴子级移动和合并规则敏感性涉及抽样产出支持的推断量。 相反,结束点暂停和两个稳定错误涉及我们的仪器和分析规格。 这些错误是评价程序在审计中可能失败的证据,而不是内在LLM非决定性的证据。 我们在结果中将这两个类别分开,并撤回其工具无法确定其原因的无障碍要求。

blocks.en: Every measurement comes from a single commercial endpoint over a bounded period, so the per-model numbers describe a model-as-served, and describe it through an instrument whose 60-second timeout § 7 shows is enough on its own to manufacture an availability finding. Nor can we prove which weights answered us: we queried by name and cannot verify the served artifact matched it, a gap Zhang et al. (2026) shows is not hypothetical, and silent revision under a stable name would be indistinguishable here from nondeterminism.
blocks.zh: 每一种测量都来自一个限定期间的单一商业终点,因此每个模型数字都描述了一个模型即时服务,并通过一个其60秒超时第7节显示足以自行制造可用性发现的仪器加以描述. 我们也无法证明哪些重量回答我们:我们问的是名字,无法证实所售文物是否相符,这是张等的空白。 (2026年) 节目不是假设的,在稳定的名字下无声修订在这里与非决定主义是无法区分的.

blocks.en: Between 64% and 100% of nodes in the synthesised regime are explicit annotations the model was told to copy (§ 2 ). The recovery campaign runs eleven models on the unannotated corpus but only four appear in both panels, so the cross-regime ordering rests on those four, and annotation status, corpus, prompt content, model panel and completion pattern all change together.
blocks.zh: 综合制度中的64%至100%的节点是明确的说明,该模型被要求复制(第2节)。 恢复运动在无说明书上有11种模式,但只有4种模式出现在两个板块中,因此,交叉制度命令取决于这4种模式,注释状态、程序、即时内容、模型面板和完成模式都一并改变。

blocks.en: Prompt-structure inference is a specialised task, and the study does not include a standard LLM benchmark or a downstream RAG, agent, or code-generation evaluation. A fully crossed second setting would be needed to estimate how often the same failures occur elsewhere. Our broader recommendations are therefore procedural safeguards motivated by this case, not an estimate of failure prevalence across LLM evaluation.
blocks.zh: 即时结构推论是一项专门任务,研究不包括标准的LLM基准或下游RAG,代理或代码生成评价. 需要完全跨越第二层,以估计其他地方发生同样故障的频率。 因此,我们提出的更广泛的建议是这一案例所激发的程序性保障,而不是对LLM评价失败率的估计。

blocks.en: Jaccard and ID-stability see node-id sets only; our drift decomposition finds metadata disagreement in cells scoring Jaccard 1, and the correctness check covers explicit annotations alone. R R varies from 2 to 5 and completion from 3/20 to 20/20, so node-set-perfection is not strictly commensurable across rows, and a prompt that repeatedly times out is plausibly one the model finds hard.
blocks.zh: Jacard和ID稳定只见节点-ID集;我们的漂移分解发现元数据在积分Jaccard 1的单元格中存在分歧,正确性检查仅包含明确的说明. R从2到5不等,完成时间从3/20到20/20不等,因此节点设置-完美不严格跨行相对应,一个反复出局的提示是模型发现困难的可信之一.

blocks.en: 9 Related work
blocks.zh: 第9条 相关工作

blocks.en: Non-determinism under nominally deterministic settings is established: Ouyang et al. (2025) document it for code generation at temperature zero, Atil et al. (2025) propose determinism metrics, and Yao et al. (2026) argue run-to-run consistency be measured semantically rather than on surface form, which our drift decomposition supports from another direction. We claim no discovery that LLM outputs vary; our contribution is the task, the cross-family design, and the released raw IRs.
blocks.zh: 在名义上具有决定性的环境下确立了非决定因素: Ouyang等人(2025年)为零温下代码生成文件,Atil等人. (2025年)提出定型度量衡,姚等人著. (2026年)论证说,跑到跑的一致性是用表层来测量的,而不是用表面的形式来测量,我们漂移的分解从另一个方向支持. 我们声称没有发现LLM的输出不同;我们的贡献是任务,跨家族设计和释放的原始IRs.

blocks.en: Systems that treat prompts as programs ( Beurer-Kellner et al., 2023 ; Khattab et al., 2024 ) assume the program is authored in their own format, and recent adequacy and mutation work over prompts ( Tambon et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) operates on requirement semantics or in-context demonstrations. None performs the inference we study. On evaluation robustness, format ( Sclar et al., 2024 ) and demonstration-order ( Lu et al., 2022 ) sensitivity show conclusions move when inputs are perturbed; our audit adds that they move when nothing is perturbed except which resample one drew.
blocks.zh: 将提示作为程序处理的系统(Beurer-Kellner等人,2023年;Khattab等人,2024年)假定程序是用他们自己的格式撰写的,近期的适足性和突变工作在提示之上(Tambon等人,2026年;Tan等人,2026年;Wei等人,2024年)根据要求的语义或内文演示操作. 没有人执行我们研究的推论。 关于评价的稳健性,格式(Sclar等人,2024年)和演示顺序(Lu等人,2022年)的敏感性表明,投入受到干扰时,结论会动;我们的审计还补充说,除了重新绘制一个投入外,没有受到干扰时,它们会动。

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en: Asking a language model for the structure of a prompt does not reliably give the same answer twice, even when that structure is marked and the model is told to copy it: Jaccard spans 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of cells are not node-set-perfect. The more consequential finding is about our own table: of the seven claims and assumptions we audit, one remains strongly supported under the audits applied (Table 2 ), and every failure was found without new data.
blocks.zh: 询问一个快速结构的语言模型并不能可靠地两次给出同样的答案,即使该结构被标记,并且该模型被告知要复制:Jaccard跨度0.39至0.96,72%的细胞没有节点设置完美. 更间接的调查结果是有关我们自己的表格:在我们审计的7项索赔和假设中,一项仍然得到所应用审计的有力支持(表2),每一项失败都是在没有新数据的情况下发现的。

blocks.en: Our recommendation is procedural: publish per-cell provenance, execute sensitivity comparisons rather than asserting them, state the merge rule and every tolerance’s units, report rank stability beside any ranking, and date the leaderboard. The corpus, the 293 raw IRs and every script are released.
blocks.zh: 我们的建议是程序性的:公布每个细胞的出处,执行敏感度比较而不是坚持这些比较,说明合并规则和每个容忍度单位,报告在任何排名之外排名稳定,与领导板约会。 主体 293个原始IRs和每个脚本都被释放了

blocks.en: The crossed campaign design calls for 11 × 19 × 3 = 627 11\times 19\times 3=627 outputs. 557 persisted. Of the 209 model-prompt cells, 156 have three runs, 40 have two, nine have one and four are empty; the 196 with at least two runs are what § 4 analyses. Of the 30 cells scoring exactly zero on exact-id Jaccard, 19 have three runs and 11 have two. blocks.en: C.1 How many reruns a consumer needs
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 消费者需要重新运行多少次

blocks.en: Two specification errors surfaced here under audit, and both are instructive enough that we report this question mainly as a cautionary result.
blocks.zh: 审计中出现了两个规格错误,两者都具有启发性,因此我们报告这一问题主要是作为谨慎的结果。

blocks.en: We do not measure a downstream tool. We measure the IR’s node count across runs, as a model-agnostic stand-in for any quantity a consumer might derive from the IR. No linter finding, coverage value, or mutation score is computed. Conclusions here transfer to a real tool only insofar as its output tracks node count, which we have not established.
blocks.zh: 我们不衡量下游的工具。 我们测量IR的节点计数, 没有计算出发现、覆盖值或突变分数。 此处的结论只转到一个真正的工具,因为它的输出轨迹节点计数,而我们尚未建立。

blocks.en: We defined r r as the smallest number of runs whose rolling mean stays within a tolerance of the long-run mean thereafter. With R R runs the long-run mean is the mean of all R R , so at r = R r=R the criterion compares a quantity with itself and always passes; "did not stabilise" is unreachable. At R R between 2 and 5 that accounts for 48 of 98 cells. Right-censoring r = R r=R is the minimum fix.
blocks.zh: 我们定义rr是最小的运行次数,其滚动意味着在此后维持在对长期平均值的容忍度之内。 随着R R 运行,长期平均值是所有R R 的平均值,因此在 r = R = R 中,标准将数量与自身进行比较,并且总是通过;"没有稳定"是无法达到的. 2至5间R,占98个牢房中的48个。 右审查r=R r=R 是最小的固定值.

blocks.en: The flag is described as relative to the long-run mean; the code compares an absolute difference of 0.05 nodes . On trajectories whose long-run means range from 5.3 to 18.0 nodes that is the difference between near-exact equality and roughly one node of slack. Cells stabilising before their endpoint go from 50 to 80 of 98, censored from 48 (49%) to 18 (18%); qwen3-coder-next 3/20 against 14/20 (Appendix F ). Under one reading half the study never demonstrably converges; under the other four fifths do. Nothing in the data distinguishes them; one undocumented word in a help string does.
blocks.zh: 国旗被描述为相对于长期平均值;代码比较了0.05节点的绝对差. 在长期涵义从5.3到18.0个节点的轨迹上,这是几乎完全平等与大约一个节点松懈的区别. 细胞在结束点之前稳定在98个细胞中的50个到80个,检查从48个(49%)到18个(18%);qwen3-coder-next 3/20对14/20(附录F.). 在读到一半之后,研究从未明显地汇合;在其他五分之四之下。 数据中没有区分它们;帮助字符串中有一个没有记录的单词。

blocks.en: Only this: among cells that stabilise strictly before their endpoint, the median is r = 1 r=1 under both readings, so where averaging helps it tends to help immediately. Any statement of the form " r r reruns suffice" is not supportable from this design.
blocks.zh: 仅此而已:在严格稳定在终点之前的细胞中,两个读数下的中位数为r = 1 r = 1,所以在平均值帮助下,它往往会立即有所帮助. 任何"r r reruns enough"的表单语句都无法从这个设计中支持.
